changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE secrets ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, clent_id VARCHAR(255), client_secret VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
CREATE TABLE tokens ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, access_token BIGINT NOT NULL, refresh_token BIGINT NOT NULL, expired_at BIGINT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP );
